description: Source code for 'iossim', an executable that runs an app in the iOS Simulator, handling simulator session management, output redirection, and environment setup.

classes.name: SimulatorDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class managing simulator session events, output streaming, and error handling.

methods.name: initWithStdioPath:developerDir:
methods.description: Initializes the delegate with paths for stdout/stderr and developer directory.

methods.name: tailOutput
methods.description: Copies simulated app's output to stdout while the app is running.

methods.name: localizedSimulatorErrorString:
methods.description: Fetches localized error message from simulator bundle.

methods.name: session:didStart:withError:
methods.description: Handles the start of a simulator session, manages output thread, and error conditions.

methods.name: session:didEndWithError:
methods.description: Handles the end of a simulator session, checks for crashes, and logs system messages.
